dynamicViews.description: The 14-step typical process, one interaction per step.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View

relationships.description: Step 1 — Draft: saves an event request with initial requirements.
Step 2 — Submission: submits the request. Mandatory fields and lead time undecided [?].
Step 3 — Assignment: assigns an Event Coordinator. Manual, no acceptance step.
Step 4 — Review: requests clarification where information is incomplete or unclear.
Step 5 — Initial approval: decides whether planning may proceed. Decision recorded either way.
Step 6 — Venue identification: searches venues by date, capacity, layout, accessibility.
Step 7 — Venue request: approves, rejects, or suggests an alternative.
Step 8 — Technical requirements: confirms and reserves what can be provided.
Step 9 — Preparation: tracks outstanding actions while staff update progress.
Step 10 — Confirmation: confirms once essential arrangements are complete.
Step 11 — Registration: registers within the permitted period, subject to capacity.
Step 12 — Changes: requests a change; the Coordinator assesses the impact.
Step 13 — Delivery: prepares the room; Technical Support prepares the equipment.
Step 14 — Completion: records attendance, notes and issues, then closes the event.

dynamicViews.description: Steps 1-5. Draft, submission, coordinator assignment, clarification, initial approval.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View

relationships.description: Step 1 — Draft: saves an event request. Name, type, dates, attendance, requirements.
Step 2 — Submission: submits the request. Mandatory fields and lead time undecided [?].
Step 3 — Assignment: assigns an Event Coordinator. Manual, follows an SOP kept outside the system.
Notifies the assignee. No acceptance step and no decline path.
Step 4 — Review: requests clarification where information is incomplete or unclear.
Answers. The exchange is retained on the event record.
Records a technical question. The Coordinator stays the liaison and owns the reply.
Step 5 — Initial approval: decides whether planning may proceed. Commits nothing.
Notifies of the decision. Approved, returned or rejected, all recorded.

dynamicViews.description: Steps 6-10. Venue booking, equipment reservation, preparation tracking, confirmation.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View

relationships.description: Step 6 — Venue identification: searches by date, capacity, layout, accessibility, facilities.
Step 7 — Venue request: submits a booking. Venues book in AM / PM / Night slots.
Approves, rejects, or suggests an alternative venue.
Step 8 — Technical requirements: notifies of the requested equipment and support.
Confirms what can be provided and reserves it. Per session where sessions differ.
Step 9 — Preparation: tracks outstanding actions, aggregated across every session.
Step 10 — Confirmation: confirms once essential arrangements are complete.
Notifies of confirmation. Confirmed arrangements become viewable.

dynamicViews.description: Steps 11-14. Attendee registration, changes before the event, delivery, completion.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View

relationships.description: Step 11 — Registration: notifies that registration has opened.
Registers within the permitted period, subject to capacity.
Step 12 — Changes: requests a change before the event.
Assesses impact on venue, equipment and registrations. Edit vs impacting change [?].
Notifies registered attendees of a confirmed change.
Step 13 — Delivery: prepares the room and records readiness.
Sets up equipment and records readiness.
Step 14 — Completion: records attendance, operational notes and issues, then closes.
